title: Wine & Jazz Series: Presented by The Melody Room
seo_title: Wine & Jazz Series with Laura French at the Gillioz
description: Wine & Jazz Series is an intimate evening of smooth jazz and fine wine presented by The Melody Room at The Gallery at the Gillioz, featuring jazz vocalist Laura French. Guests get a first glass included and can enjoy soulful performances and storytelling; tickets are general admission and the event is for ages 21 and up. It takes place Friday, November 20, 2026 at Gillioz Theatre, 325 Park Central, E Springfield, Missouri, with doors at 7:30 PM and the show at 8:00 PM.
